universe: the original 474 benchmark securities, mapped to permanent CRSP IDs using names known by 2022-05-25; later inactive securities excluded from trading using prior-day information
primary_test: original no-skip seed-0 checkpoint and original training normalizer, frozen; 2022-05-26 through 2025-12-31
source_alignment: OHLC split-adjusted CRSP prices and volumes calibrated to the original vendor's units using only overlap ending 2022-05-25
model: no_skip; original 16-day lookback, hidden=8, scales=1/2/4, lag=3/2/1, summed pair loss alpha=1, Adam lr=.005, batch=32, max epochs=100, patience=15, minimum validation loss
portfolio_PnL: CRSP total return dlyret, including dividend obligations on shorts
portfolio: top 5 long, bottom 5 short; +50%/-50% NAV at daily rebalance, gross 100%, net zero
costs: 5bp times buy dollar turnover only; long purchases and short covers pay; sales/new shorts free; start flat and include final cover
selection: no model, hyperparameter, seed, or epoch selection using test performance
other_costs: no additional borrow, financing, spread, or slippage charges beyond the requested buy cost
year_boundaries: each rolling test starts flat and ends liquidated; no cross-year order netting; all entry/cover fees included
historical_missing_labels: two unavailable pre-2022 regression labels excluded from training; no eligible validation/test return missing or excluded using future information
execution: idealized close-to-close daily benchmark, as in the original reproduction; not a live execution simulation
